tools.name: get_topic_pathway
tools.description: For a topic, the topics recommended before it (recommended_before), those that come next (next), and related topics, each with its best clip judged to teach it, or a fallback moment with its reason. tools.name: get_levels
tools.description: A topic at each Level Bettyapp has a lecture for it, from school to university: one clip a Level, the Levels as the lectures are placed. Useful for an easier or a harder explanation, or for a mixed class. A Level with no lecture is left out; Bettyapp says nothing about a Level it has no lecture at.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "teachers" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_teaching_clips, find_by_curriculum, get_clip, get_topic_pathway, get_levels · Public sink: search_teaching_clips, find_by_curriculum, get_clip, get_topic_pathway, get_levels.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_teaching_clips, find_by_curriculum, get_clip, get_topic_pathway, get_levels · Public sink: search_teaching_clips, find_by_curriculum, get_clip, get_topic_pathway, get_levels

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
